crossRefs.note: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and…
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between…

people.name: Eshtaol
people.line: City allotted to Judah and Dan; associated with Samson

people.name: Ithrites
people.line: Clan descended from Kiriath-jearim; two of David's warriors.

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

people.name: Mishraites
people.line: A clan descended from Shobal, of the tribe of Judah.

people.name: Puthites
people.line: A clan from the tribe of Judah

people.name: Shumathites
people.line: A family of Kirjath-jearim, descendants of Judah.

translations.web: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
translations.bsb: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
translations.kjv: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
translations.asv: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: The Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
